statements:
CREATE TABLE attachment_uploads (
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, execution_segment_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, relative_path TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        cleaned_at TEXT COLLATE "C", PRIMARY KEY(machine_id,command_id,relative_path)
      )

CREATE TABLE image_cleaned_turns (
            machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, native_thread_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            native_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, image_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(machine_id,logical_session_id,native_thread_id,native_turn_id,image_hash)
          )

CREATE TABLE image_uploads (
            machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, execution_segment_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, image_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, cleaned_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
            PRIMARY KEY(machine_id,command_id,image_hash)
          )

CREATE TABLE native_session_deletions (
          machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, codex_profile_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, native_thread_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
          command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(machine_id,codex_profile_id,native_thread_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE ssh_relay_streams (
        stream_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        account_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        source_machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        target_machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('opening','open','suspended','closed')),
        started_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        last_active_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        closed_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
        close_reason TEXT COLLATE "C",
        bytes_up BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        bytes_down BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      )

CREATE TABLE workspaces (
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE codex_preferences (
          workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
          scope TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('workspace','machine','project','session')),
          target_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, settings_json TEXT COLLATE "C", field_overrides_json TEXT COLLATE "C",
          revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id,scope,target_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE content_blobs (
  payload_ref TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  body_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  payload_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE host_ssh_settings (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        relay_enabled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (relay_enabled IN (0,1)),
        revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE machines (
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  public_key_spki TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  public_key_fingerprint TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  name TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  platform TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  platform_release TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  architecture TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  agent_version TEXT COLLATE "C",
  identity_state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (identity_state IN ('active','revoked')) DEFAULT 'active',
  security_state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (security_state IN ('normal','degraded_read_only')) DEFAULT 'normal',
  reachability TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (reachability IN ('offline','connecting','online','reconnecting')) DEFAULT 'offline',
  compatibility TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (compatibility IN ('unknown','compatible','incompatible')) DEFAULT 'unknown',
  compatibility_reason TEXT COLLATE "C",
  capacity TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (capacity IN ('unknown','idle','busy','saturated')) DEFAULT 'unknown',
  unreachable_reason TEXT COLLATE "C",
  active_turns BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_heartbeat_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  last_connected_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  revoked_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, codex_version TEXT COLLATE "C", schema_hash TEXT COLLATE "C", credential_protection_level TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown'
  CHECK (credential_protection_level IN ('unknown','os_keychain','software_protected','file_restricted')), security_reason TEXT COLLATE "C", current_producer_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C", display_alias TEXT COLLATE "C", command_types_json TEXT COLLATE "C", runtime_read_only BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, runtime_read_only_reasons_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', maintenance_types_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', discovery_json TEXT COLLATE "C", codex_profile_json TEXT COLLATE "C", codex_catalog_json TEXT COLLATE "C", paginated_history BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paginated_history IN (0,1)), permission_profiles BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(permission_profiles IN (0,1)), cloud_image_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, maintenance_json TEXT COLLATE "C",
  UNIQUE(workspace_id, public_key_spki)
)

CREATE TABLE permission_preferences (
          workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
          scope TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('workspace','machine','project','session')),
          target_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, profile TEXT COLLATE "C" CHECK(profile IN ('project','network','full')),
          revision BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
          PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id,scope,target_id)
        )

CREATE TABLE takeover_policies (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        idle_days BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(idle_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
        revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 1), updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE users (
  user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  email TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE ,
  password_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  role TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (role = 'admin'),
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
, identity_id TEXT COLLATE "C", disabled_at TEXT COLLATE "C")

CREATE TABLE voice_preferences (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        voice TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, revision BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE agent_connections (
  connection_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  transport_generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
  producer_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C",
  app_server_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C",
  connected_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  hello_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  disconnected_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  close_reason TEXT COLLATE "C",
  UNIQUE(machine_id, transport_generation)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_tickets (
  ticket_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  token_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  audience TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  transport_generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE client_sessions (
  client_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  token_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  csrf_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  ip_hash TEXT COLLATE "C",
  user_agent_hash TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE cloud_images (
            machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, image_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            data_url TEXT COLLATE "C", size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(size_bytes>=0), created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
            PRIMARY KEY(machine_id,image_hash)
          )

CREATE TABLE host_ssh_accounts (
        account_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        name TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(algorithm IN ('ed25519','rsa','ecdsa')),
        username TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, address TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '', port BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 22,
        public_key TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        encrypted_private_key TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, encrypted_passphrase TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        host_keys_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', verification_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        description TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '', enabled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, route TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct' CHECK (route IN ('direct','auto','relay','proxyjump')), proxy_jump_machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        UNIQUE(workspace_id,name)
      )

CREATE TABLE host_ssh_sync (
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        revision TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, results_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', synced_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE live_chat_messages (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        room_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,message_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,viewer_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,nickname TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,content TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        observed_at BIGINT NOT NULL,source TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,stored_at BIGINT NOT NULL,content_truncated BIGINT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(workspace_id,user_id,room_id,message_id)
      , rowid BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE machine_credentials (
  credential_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  token_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE machine_usage (
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES machines(machine_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, account_key TEXT COLLATE "C", observed_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, windows_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      , credits_json TEXT COLLATE "C", reset_cards_available BIGINT CHECK(reset_cards_available IS NULL OR reset_cards_available >= 0))

CREATE TABLE pending_commit_dismissals (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        root TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        token TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id,user_id,machine_id,root)
      )

CREATE TABLE "projects" (
  project_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  external_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  alias TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  canonical_root TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  identity_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  repo_root TEXT COLLATE "C",
  branch TEXT COLLATE "C",
  dirty BIGINT CHECK (dirty IN (0,1)),
  lease_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  last_reported_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, sync_content BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (sync_content IN (0,1)), retention_days BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 CHECK (retention_days IN (1,3,7,14,30)), provider TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'codex' CHECK(provider IN ('codex','claude','qwen','kimi','cursor','codebuddy','grok')), worktree_base TEXT COLLATE "C", worktree_removed BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (worktree_removed IN (0,1)),
  UNIQUE(machine_id, external_id),
  UNIQUE(machine_id, identity_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE quarantined_events (
  quarantine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  producer_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  host_seq BIGINT NOT NULL,
  payload_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  envelope_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE security_alerts (
  alert_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  code TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  detail_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  resolved_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE voice_long_term_preferences (
       id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
       body TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, conditions TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, enabled BIGINT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C", mutation_key TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
       revision BIGINT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C", updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
       UNIQUE(workspace_id,user_id,mutation_key)
      )

CREATE TABLE voice_preference_versions (
       workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
       revision BIGINT NOT NULL, reset_revision BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id,user_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE voice_transcript_settings (
        workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        enabled BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), revision BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id,user_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE writing_ai (
        user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        endpoint TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, model TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, encrypted_key TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, enabled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      )

CREATE TABLE writing_memory (
        id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, scope TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        target_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        phrase TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, replacement TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        status TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('candidate','active','deleted')),
        source_session TEXT COLLATE "C", source_event TEXT COLLATE "C", uses BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, automatic BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, source_question TEXT COLLATE "C",
        UNIQUE(user_id,scope,target_id,fingerprint)
      )

CREATE TABLE agent_challenges (
  challenge_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  credential_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machine_credentials(credential_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  nonce TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  audience TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  transport_generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE cloud_image_refs (
            owner_type TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(owner_type IN ('command','event')), owner_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, image_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(owner_type,owner_id,machine_id,image_hash),
            FOREIGN KEY(machine_id,image_hash) REFERENCES cloud_images(machine_id,image_hash) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE
          )

CREATE TABLE credential_renewal_challenges (
  challenge_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  credential_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machine_credentials(credential_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  message TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  renewed_credential_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES machine_credentials(credential_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  completed_at TEXT COLLATE "C"
)

CREATE TABLE enrollment_transactions (
  enrollment_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  bootstrap_secret_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  claim_token_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" UNIQUE,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  client_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES client_sessions(client_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  public_key_spki TEXT COLLATE "C",
  public_key_fingerprint TEXT COLLATE "C",
  verification_phrase TEXT COLLATE "C",
  proof_challenge TEXT COLLATE "C",
  requested_name TEXT COLLATE "C",
  platform TEXT COLLATE "C",
  platform_release TEXT COLLATE "C",
  architecture TEXT COLLATE "C",
  agent_version TEXT COLLATE "C",
  status TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('created','claimed','confirmed','redeemed','expired','cancelled')),
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  claimed_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  confirmed_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  redeemed_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  cancelled_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  create_ip_hash TEXT COLLATE "C",
  claim_ip_hash TEXT COLLATE "C",
  confirm_ip_hash TEXT COLLATE "C"
, credential_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES machine_credentials(credential_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, recovery_expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C", preauthorized BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, consent_at TEXT COLLATE "C")

CREATE TABLE host_ssh_access (
        account_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES host_ssh_accounts(account_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        source_machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        PRIMARY KEY(account_id,source_machine_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE host_ssh_link_tests (
        account_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES host_ssh_accounts(account_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        source_machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        ok BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (ok IN (0,1)),
        path TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct' CHECK (path IN ('direct','proxyjump','relay')),
        duration_ms BIGINT, error TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tested_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(account_id,source_machine_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE logical_sessions (
  logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  project_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  external_id TEXT COLLATE "C",
  title TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  managed BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (managed IN (0,1)),
  execution_state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (execution_state IN ('idle','running','awaiting_approval','completed','interrupted','failed','unknown')),
  reachability TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (reachability IN ('live','reconciling','unreachable')),
  thread_control_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  turn_control_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  active_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C",
  projection_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  next_session_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  control_lease_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, content_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, queue_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, management_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, codex_profile_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', session_cwd TEXT COLLATE "C", runtime_settings_json TEXT COLLATE "C", deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
  UNIQUE(machine_id, external_id)
)

CREATE TABLE machine_operations (
  operation_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  actor_client_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES client_sessions(client_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  client_mutation_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE content_tombstones (
  event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES durable_events(event_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  payload_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  deleted_content_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL,
  tombstone_content_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('expired','user_deleted')),
  deleted_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE dispatch_attempts (
  dispatch_attempt_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  attempt_no BIGINT NOT NULL,
  machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES machines(machine_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  transport_generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
  producer_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  app_server_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(command_id, attempt_no)
)

CREATE TABLE panel_voice_jobs (
        job_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        voice_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_voice_calls(voice_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, request_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        native_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C", state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('submitted','running','unknown','completed','failed','interrupted')), reported_call_id TEXT COLLATE "C", created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, UNIQUE(voice_id,request_id)
      , rowid BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE project_turn_reservations (
  project_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(project_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" UNIQUE REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  native_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C",
  state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('accepted','dispatching','active','unknown','migration_conflict')),
  conflict_count BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (conflict_count >= 1),
  version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  reserved_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
, bound_producer_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C", bound_app_server_epoch TEXT COLLATE "C", binding_state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unbound'
  CHECK (binding_state IN ('unbound','bound','legacy_unbound')))

CREATE TABLE scheduled_runs (
        run_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
        task_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_tasks(task_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        scheduled_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        status TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','dispatching','running','succeeded','failed','missed','needs_attention')),
        session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) ON DELETE SET NULL DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        detail TEXT COLLATE "C",
        created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(task_id,scheduled_at)
      )

CREATE TABLE turn_queue (
  queue_item_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
  command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  workspace_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(workspace_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  actor_client_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES client_sessions(client_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  accepted_queue_version BIGINT NOT NULL,
  position BIGINT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','dispatching','cancelled','expired','invalidated','applied','unknown')),
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(logical_session_id, position)
)

CREATE TABLE writing_history_feedback (
        user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        source_event TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        rating TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL CHECK(rating IN ('useful','unhelpful')), updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(user_id,source_event)
      )

CREATE TABLE dispatch_attempt_lifecycle (
  lifecycle_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  dispatch_attempt_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES dispatch_attempts(dispatch_attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  detail_json TEXT COLLATE "C",
  created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE dispatch_attempt_projection (
  dispatch_attempt_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES dispatch_attempts(dispatch_attempt_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE panel_voice_task_records (
        job_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES panel_voice_jobs(job_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, todo_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES panel_voice_todos(todo_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        machine_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, project_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        original_intent TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, dispatch_prompt TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, native_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C", state TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        result_json TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', result_payload_ref TEXT COLLATE "C", result_expires_at TEXT COLLATE "C",
        content_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, acknowledged_at TEXT COLLATE "C", created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE panel_voice_todo_resolutions (
        todo_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES panel_voice_todos(todo_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        job_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES panel_voice_jobs(job_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
        native_turn_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, completion_event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, final_event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        final_payload_ref TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, content_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, result_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
        actor_user_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, created_at TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE project_turn_migration_members (
  project_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES project_turn_reservations(project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  logical_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_sessions(logical_session_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
  command_id TEXT COLLATE "C" REFERENCES commands(command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE,
